title: Conqueror
description: [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] deals double damage to the enemy this turn.
smart_description: [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] deals double damage to [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold] {Amount:plural:this turn|for the next [blue]{}[/blue] turns}.
notes: Counters the Sovereign Blade card's damage multiplier. Only applies the 2x damage bonus when: (1) the card source is SovereignBlade, (2) the attack is a powered attack, and (3) the target is the power owner. The counter decrements by 1 at the end of each turn the owner participates in.
